SALES TAX SPECIAL AUDIT RULES, 1998
SALES TAX SPECIAL AUDIT RULES, 1998
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary
Part 11, 14th September, 1998]
S.R.O. 982(1)/98, dated 14-9-1998.--In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 50 of the Sales Tax *Act, 1990, the Central Board of
Revenue is pleased to make the following rules, namely:
1. Short title, application and commencement.--(1) These rules may
be called the Sales Tax Special Audit Rules, 1998.
(2) They shall apply to all registered persons who are subject to
special audit under the said rules.
(3) They shall come into force on the 1st of October, 1998.
2. Definitions.--(1) In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context,--
(a) "Act" means the Sales Tax Act, 1990;
(b) "Records" means the records as prescribed under
section 22 of the Act;
(c) "Tax Invoice" means the invoice as prescribed under
section 23 of the Act;
(d) "Monthly Return" means the Returns as prescribed
under section 26 of the Act;
(e) "Special audit" means audit conducted under these
rules;
(f) "Special auditor" means a Chartered Accountant as
defined in clause (b) of subsection (1) of section 2 of Chartered Accountants
Ordinance, 1961 (X of 1961) holding a certificate of practice under section 6
of the said Ordinance or a Cost and Management Accountant as defined in clause
(aa) of subsection (2) of section 1 of Cost and Management Accountants Act,
1966 (XIV of 1966) holding a certificate of practice under section 6 of the
said Act;
(g) "Auditor's report" means the opinion issued by the
special auditor.
3. All other terms and expressions used, but not defined in these
rules, shall have the same meanings as are assigned to them in the Act.
4. Special audit.--(1) Notwithstanding any provisions in the Act
relating to the conduct of audit, the Board may cause Special Audit of the
records, invoices and monthly Returns as required under sections 22, 23 and 26
of the Act respectively maintained by such registered persons, class or classes
of registered persons, by Chartered Accountants or by the Cost and Management
Accountants appointed by the Board.
5. Scope of Sales Tax Special Audit.--The scope of the Special
Audit shall be the expression of professional opinion about the following:--
(a) the records, invoices and monthly Returns have been correctly
maintained by the registered person;
(b) the monthly Returns filed by the registered persons
reflect/correctly,-
(i) all "taxable supplies" in the "tax period"
as revealed by the records and tax invoices; and
(ii) all "input" and "output" tax and the net
amount of tax payable or refundable, as the case may be, are in accordance with
the provisions of the Act and are duly substantiated by the records required to
be maintained for the purpose.
6. The special auditor shall submit his report in the form
prescribed in the terms of reference.
7. In case of violation of any rule or any clause of terms of
reference, the payment of fee as prescribed in such reference, shall be
withheld forthwith without prejudice to any action that can be initiated under Chartered
Accountants Ordinance, 1961 (X of 1961), bye-laws thereof or the Cost and
Management Accountants Act, 1966 (XIV of 1966) as the case may be, read with
relevant provisions of Sales Tax Act, 1990. In case the payment has already
been made in full or part thereof, the same shall be returned within one week
of issuance of demand notice in this regard.
